verdicts.reason: A cuts off the product circle at the left edge. Its subtitle wraps onto a second line, leaving 'now.' as an orphan, and the NEW pill collides with the subtitle text. Overall the left-to-right rhythm looks jammed. B keeps the original's left-to-right order (product circle, headline with a one-line subtitle, NEW pill, Try It button) with no collisions and even spacing. Its only flaw is a very small subtitle at banner size, which needs a little polish.
